args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity):
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. 2.9.4 is the
first 2.x release containing the fix.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
- fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions are `<2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`), fixed in **2.9.4**.

## Testing
- CI passed on commit c8b8ab7878 (run ci-0001).

Requesting review from @alex (code owner approval required to merge to main).
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
